contract: Conditional uniform lower bounds on two specified raw-state neighborhoods of radius exactly 1/10000 around the FC132 sources, using ternary height at most one, fixed physical addresses, gamma=1/2, fixed finite support and caps, actual-source guards and head totals at most one. Not a bound on the whole source domain.

coordinate_norms.heads: Each root/head/physical row differs by at most radius.
coordinate_norms.private: At each root/private q, |Delta g|, sup_i|Delta X_i| and sup_j|Delta Y_j| are each at most radius; X=g*x, Y=g*y.

limits: The neighborhood is intersected with the admissible common actual/raw-source domain and all row masses are nonnegative with each head total at most one.
The continuous raw min-cap function retains supported-private cap charges at zero carriers; it is not the boundary rule that discards such roots.
Fixed pure caps and inventory, physical addresses and gamma are essential; no radius optimization or source search was performed.
No global arbitrary-source positivity, arbitrary-prime extension, full AP realization of the centers, or Lean verification is claimed.
